name: _meta
script: return "地图视图（亮色）：照片/地图切换 → 标记数断言 → 点击标记开灯箱 → 空态文案。需联网加载 OSM 瓦片；城市夜行手册旅行无 GPS 承担空态。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-open-kyoto
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 03-switch-map
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '地图'); if (!b) throw new Error('地图 tab 缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 04-map-tiles-loading
script: const markers = document.querySelectorAll('.map-marker'); if (markers.length !== 11) throw new Error('应有 11 个标记，实际 ' + markers.length); 'markers-ok'

name: 06-click-marker
script: const m = document.querySelector('.map-marker'); if (!m) throw new Error('标记缺失'); m.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); 'ok'

name: 07-lightbox-from-marker
script: const lb = document.querySelector('.fixed.inset-0.z-50'); if (!lb) throw new Error('灯箱未打开'); 'lightbox-ok'

name: 09-back-home
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '返回'); if (!b) throw new Error('返回按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].length; if (n < 4) throw new Error('首页卡片缺失: ' + n); 'back-ok'

name: 10-open-city
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('城市夜行手册')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到城市夜行手册，当前: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].map(x => x.textContent).join('|')); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 11-city-map-empty
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '地图'); if (!b) throw new Error('地图 tab 缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 12-map-empty-state
script: if (!document.body.textContent.includes('还没有带位置的照片')) throw new Error('空态文案缺失'); 'empty-ok'
